thesis: As intelligence becomes abundant and inference unit prices compress, provider-to-provider token price comparison may lose strategic relevance. Measure the incremental cost and product value of adding StegGate governance to an existing model service, with governance burden segmented by the controls required for the action.
primary_comparison_unit: absolute governance cost per governed admissible action by burden class
workload_comparison_unit: workload-weighted governance cost per governed admissible action
secondary_comparison_units: governance premium as percent of underlying inference cost
incremental latency per governed admissible outcome
incremental bytes and receipt-storage cost per governed admissible outcome
admissibility lift relative to raw model execution
provider gross-margin headroom for a governed AI product tier

governance_burden_classes.description: in-process admissibility, receipt, and reconstruction verification
PROOF plus policy and delegation retrieval/verification
LOOKUP plus durable receipt persistence and reread verification

required_inputs: StegGate governance burden cost measured independently of provider inference
governance burden class or workload mix
raw and governed latency where provider-pair comparison is performed
raw and governed normalized outcome hash where equivalence is required
remote production burden evidence before production pricing claims

abundant_intelligence_modes.condition: provider inference cost remains at least 10x the measured governance burden for the action
abundant_intelligence_modes.primary_metric: provider inference plus absolute governance cost; percentage premium may remain informative

abundant_intelligence_modes.condition: provider inference cost is between 1x and 10x the measured governance burden for the action
abundant_intelligence_modes.primary_metric: absolute governance cost per governed admissible action and governance share of product floor

abundant_intelligence_modes.condition: provider inference cost is below the measured governance burden or model outputs are sufficiently substitutable that intelligence price is no longer the main differentiator
abundant_intelligence_modes.primary_metric: cost and reliability of converting model output into an authorized, admissible, reconstructable execution, workload-weighted by required governance class

product_hypothesis.name: Governed AI
product_hypothesis.provider_offer: Existing model service plus StegGate execution governance, admissibility decisioning, receipts, reconstructability, policy enforcement, and selectable control burden appropriate to the action.
product_hypothesis.commercial_question: What independently measured governance burden and provider-specific integration cost must be added to an existing AI product to offer a governed tier, and what retail price would preserve an explicitly assumed target margin?
non_claims: StegVerse makes the underlying model more intelligent
all providers or all governed actions should carry the same premium
local synthetic burden measurements equal remote production service cost
illustrative margin arithmetic proves willingness to pay

measurement_separation.provider_inference_cost: measured outside the StegGate burden meter
measurement_separation.provider_specific_integration_cost: must be measured separately when adapters, remote calls, or provider operations create non-Steggate overhead
measurement_separation.commercial_margin: assumption applied only after technical cost components are established

claim_boundary: This schema measures bounded Governed AI product economics around admissible actions. Current burden-class and workload-mix evidence is synthetic and local. It does not establish universal provider economics, production wholesale price, retail price, enterprise ROI, model superiority, or market willingness to pay.
